blocks.text: Deuteronomy 15 contains 23 verses. It opens with: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release. It concludes with: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it out upon the ground as water. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The repeated instruction is rhetorically adapted covenant exposition for a successor generation, not a simple verbatim duplication of earlier laws.
